%iso(vista, k, ox, oy):
  c:cos(π/6)
  s:sin(π/6)
  if vista=="T":
    T:[c,-c,0;s,s,0;0,0,1]
  elif vista=="L":
    T:[c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  else:
    T:[-c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  if isa(k; "circle"):
    nm:["","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","","",""]
    for j in 1..24:
      t:2*π*(j-1)/24
      Q:T*[k.c.x+k.r*cos(t);k.c.y+k.r*sin(t);1]
      nme:"C"+k+"_"+num2str(j)
      point(nme; ox+Q_1; oy+Q_2)
      nm_j:nme
    spline(nm; "cerrado")
  else:
    for i in 1..k.n:
      o:k_i
      if isa(o; "line"):
        A:T*[o.a.x;o.a.y;1]
        B:T*[o.b.x;o.b.y;1]
        point("P"+o.a; ox+A_1; oy+A_2)
        point("P"+o.b; ox+B_1; oy+B_2)
        line("P"+o.a; "P"+o.b)
      elif isa(o; "arc"):
        a0:atan2(o.a.y-o.c.y; o.a.x-o.c.x)
        sw:atan2(o.b.y-o.c.y; o.b.x-o.c.x)-a0
        sw:if(sw<0; sw+2*π; sw)
        nm:["","","","","","","","","","","","",""]
        for j in 0..12:
          t:a0+sw*j/12
          if j==0:
            Q:T*[o.a.x;o.a.y;1]
            nme:"P"+o.a
          elif j==12:
            Q:T*[o.b.x;o.b.y;1]
            nme:"P"+o.b
          else:
            Q:T*[o.c.x+o.r*cos(t);o.c.y+o.r*sin(t);1]
            nme:"A"+o+"_"+num2str(j)
          point(nme; ox+Q_1; oy+Q_2)
          nm_(j+1):nme
        spline(nm)
  k
